From the root of the project in PowerShell:

Executable code/The commands are omitted in the documentary copy.

The finished results, including timeouts, are not repeated. JOURNAL.jsonl It's finished.

  • SELECTED.json: pre-selected records and source SHA256.
  • SOURCES.json: baselines and comparison with baseline same entrances.
  • inputs/, lattices/source/: exact copies, with no new reduction.
  • results/degree/, algebra/, algebra_checkpoints/, progress/: new outcomes.
  • AUDIT.json, audit_packets/: Repeated certificates and independent algebra.
  • MEASUREMENTS.json, COMPARISON.json: All times and coupled outcomes.
  • RESOLUTION_MAP.json: baseline timeout, A new answer, the rest of the open records.
  • RETRY_INDEX.json: There are still unfinished attempts in this series.
  • PRIOR_SNAPSHOT.json, PROVENANCE.json, ENVIRONMENT.json: Integrity and origin.
  • RESUME_CHECK.json, ACCEPTANCE.json, COMPLETE.json, ARTIFACTS.json: acceptance.

One CPU-process 60 c to the new algebra, and 600 from all; audition 120 c to the entrance separately, no installations and GPU.
